mapper.select: select * from ( select concat(case when stockType = 1 then 'sh' when stockType = 0 then 'sz' else '' end, stockCode) stockCode from t_hs300 th union select concat(case when stockType = 1 then 'sh' when stockType = 0 then 'sz' else '' end, stockCode) stockCode from t_etf te union select concat(case when stockType = 1 then 'sh' when stockType = 0 then 'sz' else '' end, stockCode) stockCode from t_index ti ) t where t.stockCode like 's%' limit 100;
